sentences.text: Amy Meredith Poehler -LRB- -LSB- ˈpoʊlər -RSB- born September 16 , 1971 -RRB- is an American actress , comedian , director , producer , and writer .

After studying improv at Chicago 's Second City and ImprovOlympic in the early 1990s , she went to New York City in 1996 to become part of the improvisational comedy troupe Upright Citizens Brigade .	improv	Improvisational theatre	Chicago	Chicago	Second City	The Second City	ImprovOlympic	ImprovOlympic	New York City	New York City	Upright Citizens Brigade	Upright Citizens Brigade
The group 's act became a half-hour sketch comedy series on Comedy Central in 1998 .	sketch comedy	sketch comedy	Comedy Central	Comedy Central

Along with other members of the comedy group , Poehler was a founder of the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre .	Upright Citizens Brigade	Upright Citizens Brigade	Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre	Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre

She is best known by starring as Leslie Knope in the NBC sitcom Parks and Recreation , for which she won a Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Television Musical or Comedy Series in 2014 and a Critics ' Choice Award for Best Actress in a Comedy Series in 2012 .	Leslie Knope	Leslie Knope	NBC	NBC	Parks and Recreation	Parks and Recreation	Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Television Musical or Comedy Series	Golden Globe Award for Best Actress – Television Series Musical or Comedy

Poehler was a cast member on the NBC television series Saturday Night Live from 2001 to 2008 and became co-anchor of SNL 's Weekend Update in 2004 alongside friend and colleague Tina Fey .	NBC	NBC	Saturday Night Live	Saturday Night Live	Weekend Update	Weekend Update	Tina Fey	Tina Fey
She is also known for voicing Joy from Inside Out , Sally O'Malley from the Horton Hears a Who !	Inside Out	Inside Out (2015 film)	Sally O'Malley	Sally O'Malley
movie adaption , Bessie Higgenbottom in the 2008 -- 2011 Nickelodeon series , The Mighty B !	Nickelodeon	Nickelodeon
and Homily Clock from the American-English dub of The Secret World of Arrietty .	The Secret World of Arrietty	Arrietty

Poehler served as an executive producer on the Swedish-American sitcom Welcome to Sweden , along with her brother Greg Poehler .	Greg Poehler	Greg Poehler	executive producer	executive producer	Welcome to Sweden	Welcome to Sweden (2014 TV series)
The series aired on NBC .	NBC	NBC

She is also an executive producer on Broad City which airs on Comedy Central , and appeared in the season one finale .	Comedy Central	Comedy Central	executive producer	executive producer	Broad City	Broad City	season one	List of Broad City episodes#Season 1 (2014)

Since August 2015 , she has served as an executive producer on the Hulu original series Difficult People , which stars her former Parks and Recreation co-star Billy Eichner and comedian Julie Klausner , the latter of whom is the creator of the show .
